purpose: Teach: 歯ブラシ/酪農/石器/ニワトリ/和紙/魚介類/アヒル/下駄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは毎朝歯ブラシを新しく替えられたぞ
lines.en: When I was young, your father would replace his toothbrush every single morning.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic voice. Settling into memory. Quiet wonder at the detail itself. Gentle rhythm, as if turning something over in his hands.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃酪農のお手伝いをされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you helped out at the dairy farm when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing. Not correcting him, but gently redirecting. A small smile in her voice. The affectionate knowingness of decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは石器の歴史を勉強されたぞ
lines.en: When I was young, your father studied the history of stone tools.
lines.style: The same quiet reverence as before. Eyes focused on something far away. Pausing slightly before the object — letting it settle as a real memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭でニワトリを飼っておられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You kept chickens in the garden, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, almost playful insistence. She's not letting him drift entirely into his own past. Warm underneath, but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお手紙を和紙でお書きになったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, your father wrote letters on handmade washi paper.
lines.style: Voice growing softer. Each detail precious, discrete. Breathed quietly. The reverence deepens with each memory offered.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祝いに魚介類のお料理を作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You made seafood dishes for celebrations, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender affection layered with humor. She's building something with her gentle corrections. Voice close, intimate. A rhythm they've perfected.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが池でアヒルを見せて下さったぞ
lines.en: When I was young, your father showed me ducks at the pond.
lines.style: The gentlest of all. Almost a whisper. A memory so vivid it seems to live in his breath. Fades as if he's still there, watching.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祭りで下駄を履いてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You wore geta at the festival, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm and close. The final note — affectionate, insistent, complete. She's brought him back gently, held his hand the whole way home.
